scope: Source consolidation with editable shared recipe inputs, self-contained export, documentation/test consolidation, and translation source reconciliation.

source.note: Moved shared files are retained once, not discarded. scripts adds one Python shared-input resolver while consolidating six old CJS entries into existing suites with two shared fixtures.

changes: 63 shared resource files replace 137 recipe-local copies: complete Agent-Reach reviewed source/manifest/patch and eight common helpers; generic remains independently buildable.

Go and Python resolve sharedFiles, preserve local regular-file overrides, reject missing declared sources and unsafe/conflicting paths, materialize standalone files, and strip authoring references from frozen lock metadata.
Final context limits include generated metadata and SHA256SUMS; generated path conflicts and pre-filter variant conflicts fail explicitly.
15 guides merged into complete topical documents with stable anchors and updated links; six obsolete test entrypoints folded into named suites with retained assertions.
Five small Kun store query files merged without changing SQL, signatures or registered research APIs.
All 1800 active English translations are reconciled into one catalog; generation is stable, runtime logic unchanged, and two duplicate secondary-page script inclusions removed.

checks.scope: Final production reader after boundary fixes; complete host suite.
Real local HTTP/stdio fixtures; no external VideoApp or model.

limitations: No real Docker image build, provider authentication, GPU/model inference, external VideoApp or production Kun worker run.

Chromium authentication smoke was blocked before page launch by sandbox process-singleton socket restrictions; it is not counted as a UI pass. The corresponding demo API checks and offline DOM suites passed.

A real Agent-Reach wheel build was not rerun because hatchling and a local cached build environment were unavailable. Full reviewed source files, patch/hash manifests and local installation paths were validated.
Existing no-shared Go acceptance of colon-bearing local names and recipe-root ancestor symlinks was not changed; these are pre-existing differences from the Python validator.
Windows was cross-compiled, not executed natively. Full UHP conformance and public image distribution are not claimed.
provenance: Raw execution evidence stays outside the source release. Historical raw evidence remains in the prior source archives; only this current summary ships.
